title: Concept Guidance: Precise, Training-Free Latent Control for Text-to-Image Generation
abstract: arXiv:2608.14172v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Text-to-image diffusion models have two major drawbacks that severely limit their practical utility: (1) standard models lack an intrinsic mechanism for continuous, concept-specific guidance (e.g., for precisely controlling how aesthetically pleasing an image looks), and (2) they lack reliability for tasks requiring high local coherence (e.g., generating text or human hands). To tackle these issues, we introduce a novel notion of concept-wise mutual information and find large, concept-dependent differences between individual layers, demonstrating that the generation of specific structures is localized in distinct parts of the network. We exploit this insight by reinforcing the impact of concept-relevant layers in Concept Guidance (CoG), a precise, target-specific guidance method that works for models out-of-the-box without additional training, external models, gradients, or prompt engineering. translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14172v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：文本到图像扩散模型有两个主要缺点，严重限制了其实际应用：（1）标准模型缺乏连续、概念特定引导的内在机制（例如，精确控制图像的美观程度），（2）在需要高度局部一致性的任务中缺乏可靠性（例如，生成文本或人手）。为解决这些问题，我们引入了概念级互信息的新概念，并发现各层之间存在大且与概念相关的差异，表明特定结构的生成位于网络的不同部分。我们利用这一见解，在概念引导（CoG）中增强概念相关层的影响，这是一种精确、目标特定的引导方法，适用于现成模型，无需额外训练、外部模型、梯度或提示工程。CoG首先量化每层的概念-
tldr: 本文提出了一种无需训练的潜在控制方法CoG，通过量化层间概念互信息并增强相关层影响，实现精确的概念特定引导，解决扩散模型在连续控制和局部一致性上的缺陷。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces CoG, a training-free latent control method that quantifies concept-wise mutual information across layers and reinforces relevant layers, enabling precise concept-specific guidance while addressing diffusion models' limitations in continuous control and local coherence.
